prompt: is recycling actually worth it or just for show
reply: It depends hard on the material. Aluminium is the clearest win: remelting an old can takes a small fraction of the energy needed to pull fresh metal out of ore, and it comes back with no loss of quality, so the same metal can come back as a can again and again. Glass and steel survive the loop just as well. Plastic is the weak case: it degrades a little each cycle, sorting is expensive, and plenty gets exported or burned instead. The order still holds, use less, reuse, then recycle. ♻️ [CHIPS]Why does plastic degrade|What about e-waste[/CHIPS]

prompt: if earth is closest to the sun in january why is it not summer here

What makes a season is the 23.5 degree tilt: in January the northern half leans away, sunlight arrives at a slant and spreads thin over more ground, and the days are short. ☀️ In Australia that same January is high summer. [FACT]Earth is about five million kilometres closer to the sun in January than in July.[/FACT] [CHIPS]Why is Earth tilted|What is the equinox[/CHIPS]
